Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property.
